description.value: Taco Riendo is a Mexican restaurant mapped in the Okanagan region of British Columbia. No verified details about its physical format, address, or offerings are available beyond the OSM cuisine tag. The only discovered website resolves to an unrelated food truck in Florida.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places 'Taco Riendo' in the Okanagan region of BC, Canada (lat 49.18 / lon -119.55), but the discovered website at taco-rriendo.com clearly belongs to a food truck operating at 420 East Cowboy Way, Labelle, Florida 33935 — a different country, a different name spelling ('Taco-rriendo'), and a Florida area code (863). Because the website does not correspond to this OSM location, it cannot serve as primary evidence for any amenity or contact fields; only the bare OSM tags (amenity=restaurant, cuisine=mexican) are available. The URL was almost certainly a false positive match against a similarly-named business in another country.
concerns: Discovered website (taco-rriendo.com) belongs to a food truck at 420 East Cowboy Way, Labelle, Florida 33935 — a US business, not a BC one.
Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Taco Riendo' but the website uses 'Taco-rriendo'.
Website phone (863) 517-8955 is a Florida area code, inconsistent with a BC location.
No address, phone, or email in OSM tags to independently verify existence at this location.
URL discovery likely returned a false-positive match against a similarly-named business in a different country.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The only discovered website belongs to a food truck in Labelle, Florida, not the Okanagan BC location recorded in OSM. With no address, phone, or corroborating evidence, it is not possible to confirm this business physically exists at the mapped coordinates.
enrichment_extras.notes: Recommend manual verification of whether a Mexican restaurant named 'Taco Riendo' actually operates at or near lat 49.181099 / lon -119.5509492 in the Okanagan before including in the directory.
